description: Make CD-based PS1 games (multi-file .cue/.bin) loadable on iOS by switching the picker to a FOLDER importer with folder-scoped security access (Option 1, PRIMARY), and by enabling in-place Documents file sharing via the two Info.plist keys (Option 2, SECONDARY). Both are implemented together. Root cause: iOS grants a security scope to the single picked .cue file only, so when the C++ core (PCSX ReARMed) fopens the adjacent .bin the OS denies access. A folder scope grants the whole subtree so the core can open the .cue AND every adjacent .bin. All changes are in native/ios/ (Swift + XcodeGen spec + seed plist) and SESSION_HANDOFF.md. NO Rust, NO build-script, NO ios.yml changes; the Rust launch/need_fullpath/full_path path already accepts an absolute file path unchanged. Do NOT implement or suggest .chd conversion.
steps: In native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift, change PlayerView's picker from single-file to folder. Replace the `allowedTypes` computed property's body so the importer offers folders: set `allowedContentTypes: [.folder]` on the .fileImporter (UTType.folder is a valid system type; `import UniformTypeIdentifiers` is already present). Keep `allowsMultipleSelection: false`. Update the comment on `allowedTypes` to explain the folder rationale (folder scope grants the whole subtree so the core can fopen adjacent .bin tracks referenced by a .cue).

In the .fileImporter .success handler, the returned URL is now a FOLDER. Pass it to host.launch(url:) as before (the folder becomes the scoped URL). Keep the .failure branch writing to host.status. Keep the empty-selection guard ('no folder selected').

In EngineHost.launch(url:) treat `url` as a folder. After ensureCoreLoaded(), call url.startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() on the FOLDER and store it in `activeScopedURL` (reuse the existing lifecycle; it is released in stopSession()). Then enumerate the folder with FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(at:includingPropertiesForKeys:options:) and select the launch entry by extension priority: prefer .cue, then .pbp, then .iso, then .chd, then .bin as a last resort. Compare extensions case-insensitively (url.pathExtension.lowercased()). When multiple candidates share the winning extension, pick deterministically (sort by lastPathComponent and take the first) and note the chosen file on the HUD status. If no candidate is found, set a legible HUD error like 'no .cue/.pbp/.iso/.chd found in <folder name>', release the folder scope (stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource on the folder), clear activeScopedURL, and return without launching.

Pass the selected entry file's absolute path to engine.launch(coreId: PS1.coreId, contentId: <entry>.lastPathComponent, rom: Data(), filename: <entry>.path). Keep rom: Data() (need_fullpath is unchanged). Keep the existing do/catch: on launch failure release the FOLDER scope (activeScopedURL), clear it, set running=false, and put the error on the HUD, exactly mirroring the current balance. On success set running=true and status to 'running: <entry file name>' (optionally also naming the folder).

Preserve re-entrancy: the existing guard `if running || activeScopedURL != nil { stopSession() }` at the top of launch(url:) stays. stopSession() already stops the engine and releases activeScopedURL; since activeScopedURL is now the folder, this correctly balances the folder scope. Do not add a second startAccessing call anywhere and do not release the folder scope in a defer right after launch.

Update the HUD affordance in PlayerView: change the Button label to reflect a FOLDER is selected, e.g. host.running ? 'Open another ROM Folder...' : 'Open ROM Folder...'. Update any nearby help text/comment that says pick a file to say pick the folder that contains the .cue and its .bin tracks. Update the 'surface ready' status line if it references picking a ROM file (e.g. 'surface ready - pick a PS1 ROM folder').

OPTIONAL (Option 2 discoverability, only if low-risk and it keeps swiftc -parse clean): on core-resident/attach, scan the app's Documents directory (FileManager.default.urls(for: .documentDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first) for a folder or entry file matching the same extension priority, and if found surface it on the HUD as an alternative launch hint. Keep this minimal; the folder picker remains the primary path. Skip this if it complicates the security-scope logic. Files dropped into Documents are inside the sandbox so they need no security scope.

In native/ios/project.yml, add an `info.properties` map to the Continuum target (under the existing `info: { path: Info.plist }`). This is REQUIRED because XcodeGen GENERATES the Info.plist at info.path from auto-defaults MERGED with info.properties and OVERWRITES the on-disk file (confirmed from XcodeGen Sources/XcodeGenKit/FileWriter.swift writePlists + InfoPlistGenerator.swift). Put into info.properties BOTH new keys `UIFileSharingEnabled: true` and `LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace: true`, AND every custom key currently in native/ios/Info.plist that is NOT an XcodeGen auto-default, so the emitted plist stays complete: CFBundleDisplayName (Continuum), CFBundleShortVersionString (0.8.0), CFBundleVersion (1), LSRequiresIPhoneOS (true), MinimumOSVersion (16.0), UIRequiredDeviceCapabilities ([arm64, metal]), UILaunchScreen ({}), UIApplicationSupportsIndirectInputEvents (true), UIStatusBarHidden (true), UIViewControllerBasedStatusBarAppearance (false), UISupportedInterfaceOrientations ([UIInterfaceOrientationPortrait, UIInterfaceOrientationLandscapeLeft, UIInterfaceOrientationLandscapeRight]), UISupportedInterfaceOrientations~ipad ([Portrait, PortraitUpsideDown, LandscapeLeft, LandscapeRight]). Use correct YAML types: booleans as true/false (not strings), UILaunchScreen as an empty map {}. Do NOT restate the auto-defaults (CFBundleIdentifier, CFBundleName, CFBundleDevelopmentRegion, CFBundleExecutable, CFBundleInfoDictionaryVersion, CFBundlePackageType) unless overriding them; CFBundleShortVersionString and CFBundleVersion MUST be set here because the auto-defaults are 1.0/1 and the app ships 0.8.0/1. Keep the file valid YAML.

In native/ios/Info.plist, add the two keys `UIFileSharingEnabled` (true) and `LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace` (true) so the committed seed file remains a faithful reference to what xcodegen emits. Keep it valid XML plist (place them near the other UI/LS keys with an explanatory comment).

Update SESSION_HANDOFF.md: extend section 17 (add a subsection, e.g. (i) Multi-file cue/bin and the iOS folder scope) documenting: (1) why single-file security scoping breaks cue/bin (scope covers only the picked .cue; the core's fopen of the adjacent .bin is denied); (2) the folder-scope fix (pick a folder, hold folder-level scope for the session, enumerate for the entry); (3) the entry-file selection order (.cue > .pbp > .iso > .chd > .bin, deterministic tie-break by name); (4) the two Info.plist keys (UIFileSharingEnabled exposes Documents in Finder/Files; LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace lets the app open documents in place) enabling the drag-a-folder-into-Documents path; (5) that the keys are injected via project.yml info.properties because XcodeGen overwrites Info.plist from auto-defaults + info.properties (cite the writePlists behavior); (6) that on-device multi-file cue/bin boot and the .ipa build are verified only by the orchestrator's CI/device run, not in this sandbox. No em dashes.
acceptance_criteria: native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift's .fileImporter uses allowedContentTypes: [.folder] and allowsMultipleSelection: false.

EngineHost.launch(url:) starts a security scope on the FOLDER url, stores it in activeScopedURL, enumerates the folder with FileManager.contentsOfDirectory, and selects the entry by the priority .cue > .pbp > .iso > .chd > .bin with a deterministic tie-break.
The selected entry's absolute path is passed to engine.launch(..., rom: Data(), filename: <entry>.path); the Rust launch signature and need_fullpath usage are unchanged.

Security-scope balance is correct: exactly one startAccessingSecurityScopedResource per successful pick, released only in stopSession() (or in the no-entry / launch-failure error paths); no double-start and no defer-release-immediately.
When the folder has no loadable entry, the HUD status shows a legible 'no .cue/.pbp/.iso/.chd found' message and no launch occurs and no scope leaks.
The Open ROM button label reflects that a folder is selected.
native/ios/project.yml has info.properties containing UIFileSharingEnabled: true and LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace: true plus the existing custom plist keys, and remains valid YAML.
native/ios/Info.plist contains UIFileSharingEnabled and LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace and remains a valid XML plist.
SESSION_HANDOFF.md section 17 documents the scoping break, folder-scope fix, entry-selection order, the two keys, the project.yml injection mechanism, and the CI/device-only verification note.
No Rust files, build-core.sh, build-engine.sh, package-ipa.sh, or ios.yml are modified.
No .chd conversion is added or suggested anywhere.

python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('native/ios/project.yml')); print('yaml ok')" -> ok; and confirm UIFileSharingEnabled + LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace parse as booleans true.

python3 -c "import plistlib; p=plistlib.load(open('native/ios/Info.plist','rb')); assert p['UIFileSharingEnabled'] is True and p['LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace'] is True; print('plist ok')" -> ok.
cargo test -> 74 passing (Rust untouched, proves no regression).
cargo check --profile ios --target aarch64-apple-ios --features native-core,uniffi-bindings -> clean.

findings: Implemented both options on branch ps1-pcsx-rearmed; committed locally (not pushed). Changes: (1) native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift - PlayerView.allowedTypes now returns [UTType.folder] with allowsMultipleSelection: false; button label -> 'Open ROM Folder...' / 'Open another ROM Folder...'; surface-ready line -> 'surface ready - pick a PS1 ROM folder'; empty-selection guard -> 'no folder selected'. EngineHost.launch(url:) now treats url as a FOLDER: keeps the re-entrancy guard (if running || activeScopedURL != nil { stopSession() }), calls startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() ONCE on the folder and stores it in activeScopedURL (released only in stopSession or the no-entry / launch-failure error paths), enumerates via FileManager.default.contentsOfDirectory(at:includingPropertiesForKeys:nil,options:[.skipsHiddenFiles]) and selects the launch entry by a new helper selectLaunchEntry(in:) using extension priority .cue > .pbp > .iso > .chd > .bin (case-insensitive via pathExtension.lowercased(), deterministic tie-break by sorted lastPathComponent). Passes entry.path to engine.launch(coreId:PS1.coreId, contentId: entry.lastPathComponent, rom: Data(), filename: entry.path). No-entry -> legible HUD 'no .cue/.pbp/.iso/.chd found in <folder>' and scope released. Rust launch path unchanged. Skipped the optional Documents-scan hint to keep the scope logic minimal. (2) native/ios/project.yml - added info.properties to the Continuum target with UIFileSharingEnabled: true and LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace: true PLUS all non-auto-default seed keys (CFBundleDisplayName, CFBundleShortVersionString 0.8.0, CFBundleVersion 1, LSRequiresIPhoneOS true, MinimumOSVersion 16.0, UIRequiredDeviceCapabilities [arm64,metal], UILaunchScreen {}, UIApplicationSupportsIndirectInputEvents true, UIStatusBarHidden true, UIViewControllerBasedStatusBarAppearance false, UISupportedInterfaceOrientations + ~ipad). (3) native/ios/Info.plist - added the two keys to the seed. (4) SESSION_HANDOFF.md - added section 17 subsection (i) documenting the scoping break, folder-scope fix, entry-selection order, the two keys, the project.yml info.properties injection (XcodeGen writePlists overwrite), and CI/device-only verification. No em dashes introduced. VERIFICATION RESULTS: (1) swiftc -frontend -parse native/ios/ContinuumApp.swift -> exit 0; scope balance, .fileImporter([.folder]) shape, and FileManager.contentsOfDirectory usage reviewed by eye (exactly one start per successful pick, released in stopSession/error paths, no double-start, no defer-release). (2) python3 yaml.safe_load(project.yml) ok; UIFileSharingEnabled and LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace parse as bool True. (3) python3 plistlib.load(Info.plist) ok; both keys assert True. (4) cargo test -> 74 passed; 0 failed. (5) cargo check --profile ios --target aarch64-apple-ios --features native-core,uniffi-bindings -> Finished, clean. git diff shows only the four intended files.
